transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
xAI launches bundled subscription for Grok, Cursor and X Premium, revamps plans into five tiers from $8 to $200. Reported by 디지털투데이.
Character.ai files for bankruptcy, selling platform with Disney as lead bidder. Reported by The Times of India.
Nvidia faces shaken outlook due to US export controls affecting China's artificial intelligence chip market landscape. Reported by 핀포인트뉴스.
South Korea approves artificial intelligence law amendments to expand access to training data through a national hub. Reported by Telecompaper.
India's draft steel policy seeks artificial intelligence-supported framework for early detection of sub-standard steel imports to boost domestic competitiveness by 2047. Reported by The New Indian Express.
